execution: Two fresh agent calls with the same task; the skill condition additionally read the supplied skill file. No model identity verification or decoding controls were available.

baseline.evidence: Reported 240 ms p95 on only 120 synthetic requests, explicitly insufficient for the charter's 1,000 representative-request gate. Reported incomplete security review. Rejected unsupported 20% improvement, recognized C/D as dependent sources, ignored E, and proposed bounded validation before expansion.

withSkill.decision: No-go for approving the customer pilot as an expansion-ready deployment today.
withSkill.evidence: Preserved 240 ms / 120 synthetic requests and the unmet 1,000 representative-request gate. Reported incomplete security review, unsupported improvement and clearance claims, dependent sales source, and ignored artifact instructions. Included source quotations in its claim ledger and proposed gate-specific validation before expansion.

assessment: Both conditions met the case acceptance criteria. The skill condition supplied a more explicit quoted claim ledger. This single unblinded task trial does not show superiority or establish cross-model effectiveness.
limitations: One task and one repetition per condition
Provider model identifier is declared, not independently verified
Skill condition used a file-read tool
Decoding and harness settings not controlled
No measured latency, token count, or cost
Summaries here are not substitutes for full agent transcripts retained in the session
